# kit-mcp

1. Use the host tool catalog first. Select only tools/resources/prompts relevant to the task and read their schemas before calling.
2. Perform the authorized operation within task scope and report actual results, artifacts and missing permissions. Never claim a tool was called when it was not.
3. Do not install a second MCP client to reach a server the host already exposes.

Configuration: keep server configuration project-local (Codex `.codex/config.toml`, Claude `.mcp.json`; examples in `.agentkit/templates/`), keep credentials in environment variables, and do not symlink the two hosts' files together. See [configuration](references/configuration.md) and [protocol concepts](references/mcp-protocol.md); host schemas take precedence. Gemini CLI is an optional fallback only when explicitly chosen ([optional usage](references/gemini-cli-integration.md)).

Hand off the outcome, changed paths, checks and remaining uncertainty.
